not_a_receipt: This record is deterministic file-identity triage only. It is not an independent semantic review receipt, not a governance PASS, and does not authorize deletion, manuscript mutation, scientific execution or claim activation.

root_cause.diagnosis: Working copy resides in an iCloud-synced path; a large fraction of files are non-materialized placeholders (st_size>0, st_blocks=0) whose reads fail at the mount boundary.

sync_conflict_inventory.deletion_policy: No copy may be deleted on the basis of this record. BYTE_IDENTICAL is a necessary but not sufficient condition; see blocking_constraints.

stale_generation_hazard.finding: refine-logs holds two byte generations of the same hash-frozen record names. The ' 2.' copies are the superseded generation and are the generation most historical receipts bind to.
stale_generation_hazard.consequence: Any glob-based or name-approximate reader can silently bind the superseded generation. This is a plausible contributing cause of reviewer receipts reporting input hashes that match no current file.
stale_generation_hazard.required_control: Dispatch every recheck with explicit exact paths plus expected SHA-256, and require the reviewer to report actual measured hashes.

deterministic_recheck_of_rec_m4_precondi.method: Independent Python reimplementation of scripts/validate_rec_m4_v4.mjs treeDigest (walk, skip symlinks, sort by relative-path bytes, payload lines 'rel\tbytes\tsha256\n', sha256 of payload).
deterministic_recheck_of_rec_m4_precondi.method_cross_validation: Two of three protected trees reproduced the expected digest exactly, which validates the reimplementation.
deterministic_recheck_of_rec_m4_precondi.aggregate_finding: Zero MISMATCH across every readable protected file, protected tree and inventory item. All failures are availability failures.

blocking_constraints.reason: manuscript_src/natcs is a protected tree whose expected file_count is 72. The current tree contains exactly 72 files (71 readable + 1 dataless) with the conflict copy included, so the copy is consistent with having been inside the frozen digest at REC-M3 acceptance. Deleting it would drop the count to 71 and guarantee a protected-tree mismatch.
blocking_constraints.release_condition: Recompute the tree digest after full materialization; only then adjudicate the copy.

blocking_constraints.constraint: Do not delete any refine-logs ' 2.' copy of a hash-frozen REC record.
blocking_constraints.reason: Those copies are the superseded byte generation that 33-39 historical receipts bind to. They are provenance for historical verdicts, not garbage.

blocking_constraints.constraint: Do not treat ORPHAN_NO_BASE copies as redundant.
blocking_constraints.reason: 11 conflict copies have no surviving base counterpart, so the ' 2.' file is the only extant copy of that artifact.

blocking_constraints.constraint: Do not run make targets, test suites or scientific entry before materialization completes.
blocking_constraints.reason: Partially unreadable inputs produce false failures and, where a check treats an unreadable path as absent, false passes.

blocking_constraints.constraint: Report tracked/clean, 247/247, 85/85 and 145/145 as NOT_VERIFIABLE until git resolves.
blocking_constraints.reason: git rev-parse HEAD fails and git fsck dumps core, so no commit-relative cleanliness claim is checkable.

host_side_remediation_sequence: Materialize read-only, no writes: Finder Download Now on the repo root, or brctl download per subtree in order .git, manuscript_src, refine-logs, scripts, tests, then output/data/archive.
Verify git: git rev-parse HEAD, git status --porcelain, git fsck --full must all return normally.
Re-run this triage to convert every NOT_VERIFIABLE row to PASS or MISMATCH.
Only then adjudicate conflict copies, subject to P0-C1 through P0-C3.
Recommended: relocate the repository out of the iCloud sync domain after a git bundle or cold copy.
